But they didn't specify card. They just want estimate. So we can compute cost. Then maybe add insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to codes. So first call list_all_airports. Then parse. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

We also might need to authenticate? The get_flight_cost doesn't require auth. So no need to authenticate. So just call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost.

Let's do that.
